login.headline: Back-office console for branch staff
login.intro: Onboarding, KYC review and service requests in one place. Authorised staff only.
login.logged: All activity in this session is logged.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use your staff ID and password.
login.locked: This account is locked after too many failed sign-ins. Ask an administrator to unlock it.
login.invalid_one: Staff ID or password is incorrect. 1 attempt left before the account is locked.
login.invalid_other: Staff ID or password is incorrect. {{count}} attempts left before the account is locked.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.signedOutIdle: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
login.signedOutExpired: Your session ended. Sign in again.

change.title: Choose a new password
change.required: You signed in with a one-time password. Choose your own before you continue.
change.subtitle: Change the password you use to sign in.
change.rules: At least {{min}} characters. Common passwords and ones containing your staff ID or name aren't allowed.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.idIntro: Enter your staff ID. We'll send a 6-digit code to your registered mobile and e-mail.
forgot.codeSent: If the staff ID is registered, a code was sent to {{sms}} and {{email}}.
forgot.devHint: Practice environment: codes arrive in the dev inbox.
forgot.wrongCode_one: That code is incorrect. 1 attempt left.
forgot.wrongCode_other: That code is incorrect. {{count}} attempts left.
forgot.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
forgot.startAgain: This code can't be used any more. Start again.
forgot.tokenExpired: Too much time passed since the code was checked.
forgot.done: Your password was changed and you were signed out everywhere else.

request.title: Request staff access
request.subtitle: For new joiners and transfers. An administrator checks every request.
request.subscribe: E-mail me about training sessions for new staff
request.duplicate: A request from this e-mail address is already waiting for a decision.
request.next1: An administrator reviews it, usually within one working day.
request.next2: You'll get an e-mail with your staff ID when it's approved.
request.next3: Your administrator gives you a one-time password; you choose your own at first sign-in.
request.termsBody: Bank systems are for authorised work only. Don't share your credentials, don't look up customers without a business reason, and report anything suspicious to your branch administrator. All activity is logged.
request.privacyBody: We use your name, contact details and employee number to create and manage your staff account, and keep an audit log of what you do in the system for as long as the law requires.

consent.title: Cookies on this site
consent.body: We use necessary cookies to keep you signed in and secure. With your permission we'd also use analytics and personalisation cookies to improve the service.
consent.necessaryHelp: Sign-in session and security. Always on.
consent.analyticsHelp: How pages are used, so we can fix what's slow or confusing.
